result.brief: 提出基于Growing Neural Gas码本与图距离软交叉熵的掩码图像建模，将视觉基础模型蒸馏为紧凑离散表征，用于视网膜OCT分类与分割。
result.reason: Distills ViT foundation models into discrete codebooks with graph-guided masked image modeling, a visual representation-learning contribution (MIM, tokenizer-like discretization) transferable to RAE-style latent design.
